label: YouTube Comments Scraper
title: YouTube Comments Scraper: Comments, Replies & Likes
metaDescription: Export YouTube comments with author, likes, timestamps and nested replies from any video. Ready for sentiment analysis and audience research.
intro: Give it YouTube video links and get every public comment with its author, likes, timestamp and nested replies, exported as JSON, CSV or Excel.
useCases: Run sentiment analysis on reactions to a launch or an ad
Find the questions viewers ask to plan new videos
Audit a comment section or pick giveaway winners

faq.q: Can I get replies to comments too?
faq.a: Yes. Set the maximum replies per comment above 0 and each comment comes with its nested replies.

faq.q: How many comments can I get per video?
faq.a: You set the maximum per video (at least 10). The actor pages through the comments YouTube shows publicly, sorted by top or newest.

officialApi: The YouTube Data API v3 can list comments, but you need a Google Cloud project and an API key, and you stay within 10,000 quota units a day by default. This scraper needs no key and no quota.
